text.legendary.arc.common-work-rivet.unavaila: No worn physical equipment or nearby damaged support can take the common-work rivet; it remains whole.
text.legendary.arc.common-work-rivet.status_c: movement may take another action; rest or wait it out
text.legendary.arc.common-work-rivet.result: The master rivet repairs {equipment} worn items and seats {supports} supports; shared resistance leaves three-action fatigue.
text.legendary.arc.counterclaim-lodestone.una: No nearby embodied claimant carries a physical weapon; the lodestone remains quiet.
text.legendary.arc.counterclaim-lodestone.int: disarmed into the lodestone pile; deciding whether to recover or withdraw
text.legendary.arc.counterclaim-lodestone.res: The lodestone strips {dropped} physical weapons into one recoverable pile, including the courier's; every nearby claimant hears the iron report.
text.legendary.arc.lee-cloth-brooch.unavailab: No present wind, rain or fog can fill the lee cloth; the brooch remains fastened.
text.legendary.arc.lee-cloth-brooch.result: The clasp raises an eight-action local lee: storm movement, sight and prepared aim remain usable, while the snapping cloth reports the shelter.
text.legendary.arc.channel-surety-shuttle.una: The shuttle needs a straight lane of two to four marked water cells and a dry landing; it remains wound.
text.legendary.arc.channel-surety-shuttle.no_: ; no cargo was carried to pay the surety
text.legendary.arc.channel-surety-shuttle.res: The shuttle crosses {water} water cells to {x},{y}{cargo}. The landing line rings.
text.legendary.arc.grant.packed: packed and selected if no other relic is readied
text.legendary.arc.grant.ground: left physically beside the final witness
text.legendary.arc.common-work-rivet.descript: A master rivet repairs worn equipment and nearby supports together, but the resisting work leaves the bearer fatigued.
text.legendary.arc.counterclaim-lodestone.des: A strange ironstone strips nearby human weapons into one recoverable pile—including the courier's readied weapon—and rings an alarm.
text.legendary.arc.lee-cloth-brooch.descripti: A sailcloth clasp gives eight actions of lee from a storm's push and glare; its snap alerts nearby listeners.
text.legendary.arc.channel-surety-shuttle.des: A weighted line carries the courier over a straight marked water lane; the heaviest cargo stays at the launch and the landing is loud.
